svg.title: The measured interval changes the result on the same cases

cc:Work.dc:title: The measured interval changes the result on the same cases
cc:Work.dc:description: Every one of the 1881 original selected cases is retained. Published C-minus-A has 5 differences below 300 seconds; intended C-minus-B has 713, including 121 negatives. Legacy selection and eligibility remain unchanged.
